title: Source evaluation: kompanije.net (found while sizing the APR spike)
why_this_file_exists: This source was not the subject of FUZZ-41; it surfaced while counting how many businesses sit under each facade activity code. It is kept separate from sources-contractors.json (FUZZ-4's registry) so the provenance stays clean. Merge it into that registry when someone re-runs the source survey.

sources.name: Kompanije.net - Srbija (regionalni adresar firmi)
sources.category: APR-derived national business directory, indexed by KD-2010 activity code
sources.estimate_method: One fetch per activity-code category page under /Srbija/, counting unique company detail links in the returned HTML. Core contractor codes: 43.29 l69=652, 43.31 l70=900, 43.34 l73=2619, 43.39 l74=2880, 43.99 l76=2779. Sum 9,830, before cross-category overlap. Store side: 46.73 l548=1486, 47.52 l483=2166, 46.74 l549=925, plus l508 posredovanje=101 -> 4,577. Adjacent codes: 43.32 l71=551, 43.33 l72=2121, 43.91 l75=329, 41.20 l56=5663.
sources.cross_check: 9,830 all-form records in the five core codes vs 2,290 ACTIVE COMPANIES in the same codes counted in APR's own open data (openapi.apr.gov.rs, cut 2026-07-31). The ~7,540 difference is sole traders. Independently corroborated on the site's legacy /preduzetnici/ index, which counts 8,001 for the same five codes - the two surfaces agree within ~6%.
sources.phone_coverage_estimate: MEASURED 68% (51 of 75) on the modern /Srbija/ surface: 43.31 19/25 (76%), 43.34 20/25 (80%), 43.39 12/25 (48%). A separate 100-record sample on the legacy /preduzetnici/ surface measured 56% (56/100), of which 41 numbers were mobile (06x) and 28 landline - mobiles dominate. Street address present on 23-24 of every 25 sampled on the modern surface. Phones render as +381.(0)64.4320025, comma-separated when multiple; libphonenumber-js parses them after stripping the '.(0)' shim.

pagination.how_addressed: None. Every record in a category is rendered on one static page - /Srbija/l70_Malterisanje.html is 138,625 bytes with all 900 detail links. Two surfaces exist: modern /Srbija/<slug>/<id> (full street address, 4-digit sifra delatnosti) and legacy /preduzetnici/p<id>_<slug>.htm reached via /preduzetnici/preduzetnici.php?delatnost=<6-digit code> (street name only, 6-digit code). Fetch the category page, then one request per detail page.

sources.robots_allows: ALLOWED, by absence of any rule. https://www.kompanije.net/robots.txt (HTTP 200) contains ONLY the Cloudflare content-signals comment header - no User-agent line, no Disallow, and no content-signal values set. Nothing is restricted and nothing is granted by signal.
sources.recommended_approach: cheerio, no JS. Two requests per record is the floor: one category page (gives every detail URL) plus one detail page each. ~9,830 core contractor records + ~4,577 store records = ~14,400 detail fetches, about 4 hours at 1 req/s. Anchors use SINGLE quotes (href='./slug/12345') - a double-quote-only href regex silently matches nothing. The detail page is a label/value list; read the line after the exact label text 'Telefon:', 'Adresa:', 'Matični broj:', 'PIB:'. Guard against the empty case: when a field is blank the next line is the FOLLOWING LABEL, so reject any value ending in ':'. The 'Sajt:' label is followed by a prose sentence rather than the next label, which makes a naive parser report a website on every record - it reported 67% before the bug was caught, and the true website coverage is near zero.
sources.duplicate_risk: HIGH against apr-opendata on the company side (both derive from APR; join on maticni broj, which this source exposes and the open data uses as its record key). LOW-to-MEDIUM against the web directories already harvested (portal-srbija, gradjevinarstvo.rs, navidiku.rs) - those skew to firms with a marketing presence, this one is register-derived and reaches sole traders that have none. Dedup on normalized phone first, then maticni broj.
sources.priority_reason: Under this project's rule - rank by phone-number yield above everything else - ~9,830 core-code records at a measured ~68% phone fill is roughly 6,600 phone-bearing facade records, mobiles included, for 0 RSD. It attacks the preduzetnik gap that the repo calls the project's largest structural coverage gap, and it is the reason FUZZ-41 recommends deferring the APR purchase.
open_questions_before_relying_on_it: FRESHNESS IS UNMEASURED. The footer reads '(c) Kompanije.net 2014'. The legacy /preduzetnici/ index tops out near record id 335903 while the modern /Srbija/ section reaches 382240, so the two surfaces are snapshots of different vintages and neither carries a date. Measure the dead-record rate before exporting anything.

Validate names and maticni broj against the APR open-data company list; there is no equivalent register-grade check available for the sole traders, which is exactly what an APR purchase would provide.
The site invites visitors to edit a company's own record ('Izmeni podatke'), so a phone may be user-submitted rather than register-derived. Treat every number as needing first-call verification.
Phone format +381.(0)NN.NNNNNN suggests a bulk telephone-directory join rather than APR's registered kontakt podaci. Provenance of the phone field is unconfirmed.
sources.compliance_notes: Public business-contact data, no login, no CAPTCHA, no rule in robots.txt to respect or breach. Rate-limit to <=1 req/s and identify the crawler honestly - unlike pretraga.apr.gov.rs, this host does not block an honest User-Agent.
